name: Impeccable
tagline: A design toolkit that teaches your AI coding tool real design sense - like hiring a designer who reviews every page.
sentence: Install one skill, and your AI gets 24 design commands - from 'polish' (the final pass before shipping) to 'critique' (a scored review) to 'bolder' (amplify a timid design) - plus a 62-rule detector that flags common AI-generated patterns without needing an internet connection.

visual.alt: A hotel website for Villa Castagneto in Liguria showing elegant serif typography reading 'Fourteen rooms on a cliff. Ours since 1961,' muted earth tones, a hand-illustrated seaside villa scene, and real photography with breakfast terrace and room views.
visual.caption: A page built with Impeccable - real typography, hand-illustrated art, and a color palette from the place itself.

board.say: AI-built websites all look the same: centered text, safe colors, generic layouts. They work, but nobody would mistake them for something a designer made.
You install the skill and tell your AI to build a page, or run a command like /impeccable polish or /impeccable critique on an existing one.
Your project - a new page to build, or an existing one to review.
The skill gives your AI a design vocabulary and a detector that catches common mistakes.
steps: Applies design commands: 'polish' for a final pass, 'bolder' to amplify a timid design, 'quieter' to tone down a loud one, 'critique' for a scored review
Runs a 62-rule detector that flags AI-generated patterns (generic gradients, centered everything, rounded corners on everything, safe blue buttons)
Reviews typography, color, spacing, animation, and responsive behavior
The 'audit' command writes a technical quality report covering accessibility, performance, theming, and responsive design

board.say: A website that looks like a designer made it, with a report showing what was caught and fixed.

outputs.eg: A hotel website with serif typography, earth-tone palette, and illustrated artwork instead of stock photos
A scored report: 'Typography: 8/10 - good font pairing. Layout: 6/10 - too centered, needs asymmetry.'
The detector flagged 4 AI patterns: generic gradient, uniform border-radius, centered hero, and no custom illustration

before: AI builds a page that technically works but looks like every other AI-generated page
Asking the AI to 'make it look better' changes colors but keeps the same generic structure
No way to check whether a page 'looks AI-made' without showing it to a real designer
after: 24 design commands give specific direction: 'bolder' to push a timid design, 'polish' for the final pass, 'critique' for a scored review
A 62-rule detector catches common AI patterns without an internet connection or API key
Works in 19 coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Copilot
uses_note: Impeccable is about a year old and has 96K stars. Most public discussion is by developers comparing design skills, and detailed before-and-after case studies are thin.

steps: Install the skill: run `npx impeccable install` in your project folder
Reload your coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or any of the [19 supported agents](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable))
Try `/impeccable polish` on an existing page to see the design pass, or `/impeccable critique` for a scored review without changes
try.paste:
/skillspector https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable
Then: Install with `npx impeccable install`, reload, and run `/impeccable polish` on an existing page to see the design pass in action.

footprint.disk: The skill is a set of text files. The 62-rule detector is a standalone script. Total size is no data found.
footprint.memory: Runs inside your coding tool - no separate process. The detector runs locally without an API key.
footprint.runs_on: Any machine that runs one of the 19 supported coding agents. Node.js needed only for `npx impeccable install`.

best_for: Anyone who uses AI to build web pages and wants them to look professionally designed
Teams who want a quick design review before shipping a page
Non-designers who need more than 'make it prettier' from their AI
skip_if: You already have a designer or a formal design system
You don't build web pages with an AI coding tool
You want a visual design tool - Impeccable is a skill that guides your AI, not a drag-and-drop editor

watch: **Design is subjective.** Impeccable teaches one design philosophy. The 62-rule detector catches common AI patterns, but 'good design' is still a judgment call.
**Results vary by AI model.** The skill guides the AI, but the quality of the output depends on which model your coding tool uses. Larger models follow the design vocabulary more closely.
**The detector runs without an LLM.** The 62-rule detector is deterministic - it checks CSS and HTML patterns without calling an API. The design commands (polish, bolder, critique) need the AI model.
**Creator: Paul Bakaus.** Made by the creator of jQuery UI, currently at Google. The project began from Anthropic's frontend-design skill and is licensed Apache 2.0.
